material.description: NIST AMS 200-2 describes integration of MTConnect and other smart-manufacturing standards/technologies to collect, curate and reuse data from shop-floor equipment to improve production-system performance. This supports the data-collection and reuse pathway; it is one documented test-bed implementation, not a universal architecture. The report is NIST Technical Series; its authors are identified as NIST Engineering Laboratory staff and reuse is subject to NIST's published technical-series rights terms.
